name: Destiny
about: Destiny (2001-006B), a crewed vehicle (ISS Module), launched 2001 Feb  7. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (ATT).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2001 Feb 14), held fixed
docked to A06444; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
